about: Card text and thumbnails for the .rfm1 files of Quixotic7/RemoteFM1FW, by manifest id (catalog/SCHEMA.md).

amb.what: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: it plays itself from the start, breathing voices, bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass. You do not perform it, you tend it.
amb.author: C. Vestal

arcticscream.author: PolarPatch
arcticscream.what: Arctic Scream is a dark-ambient drone machine built on GR!MM: four tracks over FM, supersaw, formant, tonewheel, physical-model, phase-distortion and sample sources, plus Holvut, a feedback string-and-body loop that wakes, howls and overblows into screams. Drones wander and build like a storm; WARP and MORPH twist the sound, with a huge SPACE reverb and freeze, GRAIN, TAPE and a HORROR scale.

aurora.author: twochannels
aurora.what: Epic film sounds: an eight-voice spectral pad of sine partials that drifts on its own, a swarm of saws, shaped wind, a shimmer plate, a tape delay and a freeze that holds a cloud of grains. Every page is a picture the four knobs shift, and HOME is an aurora bent by the sound.

berlinan.author: Jiří Píša
berlinan.what: Berlinan is a generative Berlin School sequencer: a small ensemble of voices repeat, drift against each other on loops of unequal length and earn their mutations over time, the same as Berlinan for macOS. It makes no sound itself: each voice goes out over MIDI on its own channel to your synths, and you steer the arranger, density, tension and snapshots from the panel.

bytemania.author: llozd
bytemania.what: Bytemania is a bytebeat synth: each sound is one line of code, a formula of t that makes an 8-bit sample every step, and the key sets how fast t runs. 30 built-in patches, tuned waves and credited classic bytebeats; write your own with a live compiler or roll random ones. The knobs bend variables inside the formula while it plays, with loops, voice modes, a raster or scope view and 64 user slots.

caravel.what: Felucca continued: a multi-engine synth with ANALOG, SEM, HADES, PHASE, TRIO, a tonewheel, FM6, physical models, voices, samples, grain and slices, drums, noise and an experimental DRONE engine. Pair Morph blends two engines, a HOME screen of your own and free macros a track for live sound design.
caravel.author: BonszaiMusic

carnacos.author: Owen Kirby
carnacos.what: Carnac OS is a two-layer wavetable synth themed on the standing stones of Carnac: 15 morphing wavetable banks including SH-2-style Foundations shapes, synthesised PCM waves (choir, horns, pan flute, chimes) and seven voice architectures, among them STRIKE with 20 Neolithic attacks. Filters, mod slots, spring, tomb and tank reverbs, tape and BBD delays, a sequencer and an arpeggiator.

chipbox.author: pbarilla
chipbox.what: Chipbox turns the FM-1 into a box of classic sound chips: NES, Game Boy, Master System, PC Engine, Atari, VRC6, AY, Mega Drive FM, OPL, SID and dozens more, each a channel with its own drum kits. Write tunes in a step rack, chain pages into songs and punch in tape and FX live; every console has its colours and each power-on a different retro boot screen.

choralroot.what: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.
choralroot.author: Quixotic7

clipper.tag: Deep synth grown out of SLOOP
clipper.what: A deep synth grown out of SLOOP: 23 engines and 407 sounds, from HYBRID (three oscillators, two filters, a mod matrix) to six-operator FM, wavetables, wave sequencing, a Juno and physical models; arp, step sequencer, MPE and a web editor for every parameter.
clipper.author: isod89

coralflower.what: Chords after the Orchid, with controls made for the FM-1: one key plays a chord with a bass note. Also 27 scales, an arpeggiator, a sequencer with drums and a song mode, and a pixel flower that grows as you play.
coralflower.author: FicusFicusov

ctl1.author: Charles Vestal
ctl1.what: CTL-1 turns the FM-1 into a MIDI controller: keys with velocity and aftertouch in any scale with chords under the black keys, four knobs sending controllers in four banks, an arpeggiator and a four-track Euclidean drum sequencer on its clock. Everything goes out as MIDI, and the built-in General MIDI sounds play along, so it works with nothing connected.

drift.author: Fabian Freitag
drift.what: DRIFT is an ambient synthesizer and generative sequencer by Fabian Freitag, based on Felucca: classic synth sounds, warm basses, pads and plucks over a repeating generative Euclidean sequencer, with probability, chaos and timing variations that keep moving while you edit. Two oscillators, a resonant filter, delays and six reverbs from Room to Submarine, scale-locked keys and a minimal monochrome interface.

duell.what: A MULTIMORPHING bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound. Ten engines including wavetables, twin filters, effects and a mod matrix. Layer, dual or stereo mode. Velocity sensitivity and aftertouch. Dual core.
duell.author: OSCILL/R

dungeontracker.author: BourbonWX
dungeontracker.what: Dungeon Tracker is a Felucca fork that makes the FM-1 an old-school four-track FM groovebox, with a first-person dungeon crawl on HOME that your song plays. Each track is a party class (drum rogue, chord cleric, bass fighter, lead mage), with FMKIT drums, two-operator FMTONE, Ambika-style WAVES, a SID voice and LOFI and DUNGEON kits. Dice roll sounds, and every power-on writes a fresh song.

etch.author: SikkenWorks
etch.what: ETCH is a drawn-wavetable synth: draw three 128-point waves right on the screen, morph between them, and shape them with wave effects, modulation, organic and evolving motion and a full effects chain. Eight voices, an arpeggiator, a sequencer, projects and presets; a simple Play-and-Shape mode, or Advanced with all 63 screens.

fartmachine.author: A. C. Wilson
fartmachine.what: A questionable musical instrument: ten artisanal farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer.

felucca.what: The custom firmware the others build on: the FM-1's own synth engines, a sequencer, effects and a better panel, with an editor in the browser.
felucca.author: Hügelton

fimba.what: A physically modelled kalimba: tines laid out like the real one, thumb-roll chords, mbira patterns, a sound hole to cover, grains, tape and a plate reverb. Play it in the browser first.
fimba.author: J. Sowers

fmel1.author: AntonioAltea
fmel1.what: FMEL-1 turns the FM-1 into a Mellotron: every key plays its own length of real tape, recorded from Taijiguy's 1973 M400S: flute, choir, cello and vibes, plus a lo-fi piano. Layer a second sound and colour it with tape wow, flutter, hiss and wear, vibrato, echo, hall or plate reverb, a speaker EQ and a half-speed motor switch. ARP and a 16-step sequencer play along, and Javi's animated players act out each sound.

fmini.what: A three-oscillator monosynth in the spirit of the classic Moogs: a 24 dB/octave ladder filter, two contours, 100 factory patches, an arpeggiator, a sequencer and MIDI. Built on Felucca.
fmini.author: ruppert

fomni.what: A chord harp inspired by the Omnichord: strum the white keys, pick chords on the black ones.
fomni.author: C. Vestal

frasil.author: Styves Goupil
frasil.what: An ambient drone instrument: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key. Three layers a voice into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze; GLINT's icy FM bells on top, by hand, arpeggio or sequence; BASS a deep line below, held or sequenced; three LFOs keep it all moving.

ghoulbox.what: Dungeon synth: a cathedral hall reverb, tape and crush, a hurdy-gurdy engine, choirs, organs and recorded psaltery and harp, an old-RPG screen with wall torches.
ghoulbox.author: J. Persinger

golana.author: Gadlele
golana.what: Golana turns the FM-1 into one deep analog-style synth laid out like the microKORG: two oscillators with sub, drift and a wavefolder, five filters including a screaming MS20, two envelopes, two LFOs and a four-slot patch bay. Poly, mono, legato or eight-voice unison, ten arp types and a 16-step sequencer with slides, chorus to METAL distortion, delay and reverb. Every page draws what it does; 32 programs.

grimm.what: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: 4 tracks, 7 sound sources, real recorded choirs, tracks that play by themselves, and long tape, granular and reverb effects.
grimm.author: GRiMMBIENT

guitchordi.author: Stoogs
guitchordi.what: GuitChordi turns the FM-1 into a six-string chord instrument: the black keys pick from eleven chord slots and the white keys are the strings, with soft, normal and accent zones. 16 synthesized guitars, harp, bowed violin, pizzicato cello, bass and dulcimer on a physical string model, 50 chord styles from jazz and blues to lo-fi, 14 tunings, editable voicings, and Freeplay, Strum and Arp modes.

hawkchua.author: plieuwski
hawkchua.what: HAWK CHUA turns every voice into a live Chua's circuit: its CHAOS knob walks from a clean cycle through period doubling into the double scroll, or picks one of 30 noise programs. Vactrol-style gates feed Rings resonators and waveguides, then temple, cathedral and mosque shimmer reverbs, while the screen draws each voice's attractor. 512 GM-style presets, phrase generators, an arpeggiator and a four-track tape recorder.

hortator.what: A drum machine: eight tracks of drums, a step sequencer, Grids, a pumping compressor, LFOs, resonators and live effects. Press PLAY to hear the power-on pattern.
hortator.author: DEADACTIVE

hyp1.author: RedtailWorks
hyp1.what: Hypnotic techno and acid: a breathing pad, a deep drone, a generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Flip patterns on the bar, break it down, build it up. Forked from AMB-1. One of a pack of four: LOF-1 (a lofi groovebox), ECO-1 (a plant plays it) and GRAV-1 (a star and its planets), experimental, on its project page.

jiant.what: A bio-synthetic groovebox: six tracks drawn as living beings in thermal colours, eight engines (FM6 with Dexed, analog, phase, voice…), mutating macros, song mode from SLOOP. Not yet tested much on a real FM-1.
jiant.author: juanjiant

karma.what: A four-track groovebox: an acid bass or a Juno-style poly, physical modelling, two dozen synthesis models and a drum synth. A 64-step sequencer with song mode, generators that write parts on one chord plan, pixel characters, and USB audio with six stems, MIDI out and DAW sync.
karma.author: Ariel Muchnik

kwasub.author: Guizmoh
kwasub.what: K-WASUB is a bass synthesizer for drum & bass, dub, dubstep and techno: two oscillators each running one of several engines (analog, super/reese, wavetable, FM, phase distortion, wavefolder, hard sync, vocal, CS), morphable, with a synthesised sample layer for attack and texture, a seven-character filter, tempo-locked LFOs for wobble and an effects rack. SEQ BASS, an arpeggiator, drums and live effects.

matryoshka.author: glvno
matryoshka.what: Matryoshka is a patchable modular synth in the spirit of the Nord Modular: its web editor builds patches from oscillators, filters, envelopes, sequencers and drum maps, and the FM-1 plays them as pages of devices. Factory instruments recall classic synths and drum machines (Oracle V, Silver Box, Cassia 1, 808 and 909 kits), with a step sequencer, songs and a live link to the editor.

melodee.what: Total playing pleasure, far beyond Felucca: recording without quantize, microtonal scales, a Casio CZ-1, a bit-by-bit Dexed, scale modes made for an MPC Sample as its companion.
melodee.author: keremimo

minitone.what: Felucca with six tracks and new engines: SID, Braids' 48 models, a TB-303 and engines after Elektron's Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2, a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. Built on Felucca 1.5.
minitone.author: S. Schmitz

mnm1.author: galfaroth
mnm1.what: MNM-1 is a six-track synth groovebox forked from Hortator: each track runs a machine (SuperWave, SID, FM, VO-6, GND, MONO2K voices and drums, or effects routed through buses), with a resonant filter, a synced tape delay and three LFOs per track. Up to 64 steps with parameter locks, slides, probability, ratchets and arpeggiators, and 330 factory sounds.

modelar.author: hirakos999
modelar.what: MODELAR is a semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four oscillators sound all the time and modulate each other through eight routings. The white keys are a 4x4 XY pad that opens the filter, drives the cross-modulation and fades the effects in; the black keys play 11 gestures that move the cursor on their own. Raise K1 to K4 to bring the oscillators in.

mono2k.author: Sequencist
mono2k.what: MONO2K is a tribute to Elektron's Monomachine: six mono tracks, each running one machine (FM, superwaves, wavetables, a SID, a formant voice, effects and four drum synths). A 64-step sequencer with parameter locks, trig conditions, ratchets, per-track lengths and Grids lanes drives them into a lofi bus with reverb, ADPCM crunch, drive and 22 performance effects, on a dithered 1-bit screen.

mope1.author: slothpallas
mope1.what: MOPE-1 is a sad wavetable synth with a backing band, like an old toy keyboard that only plays depressing beats. A glossy pixel blob in a rainy room is the screen: cutoff closes its eyes, resonance turns them into lasers, the delay makes it cry a tear per echo. PLAY starts the band, REC loops over it, ARP arpeggiates. It plays anyway.

mutabledreams.author: Kid Bunka
mutabledreams.what: Six synth tracks, or a Lo-Fi sample kit plus three synths, with Plaits, Rings and Elements voices inspired by Mutable Instruments. 156 factory Biomes and 352 tone presets, per-track LFOs, granular effects, 32-step sequences, chord journeys and User Banks.

niagaradrift.author: E. Yerburgh
niagaradrift.what: Two drones that breathe and drift on their own, after the Lyra-8, Subharmonicon and DS-2: twelve presets on the white keys, gestures and scenes to move them, an LFO, delay and a reverb that freezes. Press PLAY to fade them in.

obervave.what: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84, now on four tracks: each its own sound, arp and sequence; a mixer with chorus, delay, plate reverb and drive sends, a master with DJ filter and compressor. Tracks start on the bar, patterns keep their sounds.
obervave.author: zvenson

penumbra.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
penumbra.what: Penumbra is a space-drone instrument: switch it on and a deep five-voice drone swells in on a pedal. VOX plays a soft voice on the white keys, always in the scene's key, far back in a long shimmer reverb; BLOOM is a slow swell and a looper follows the key. Holds throw, bend and freeze the sound, MORPH walks from scene to scene. Six journeys and eight user slots.

perf1.author: deamonSLINKY
perf1.what: PERF-1 is a live-performance groovebox: pick one of 170 pieces across 17 genres and five tracks play themselves (pad, bass, 303-style acid, FM pluck, drums). Steer it live: break down, build and drop, throw any of 93 effects, mute and solo, or let the auto-DJ run the arc, over a deep sequencer, DX7-style FM voices and a Jam page where every key is in the scale.

pigeon.what: An old-school hip-hop and house sampler after the SP-404 and the PO-33: two song samples and a 16-pad kit, up to 32 chops a song, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and a song arrangement. Built on Felucca.
pigeon.author: The Shrimp Blimp

purplemonkey.what: A first instrument for toddlers: random key bashing and knob turning are rewarded with dancing animated pets and little musical sequences. Press a key, any key.
purplemonkey.author: Quixotic7

rainbow.what: A music toy for little children: 63 cartoon friends, every key in tune, chords, strumming, songs to follow and an ear game, notes on a staff, a volume cap for small ears.
rainbow.author: J. Bartlett

ravel.author: De-Pattern
ravel.what: A pocket groovebox for sound design: eight tracks that synthesize, strike and drum, and play, excite and reshape one another through an influence grid. Thirteen synth engines (VA, a full Casio CZ, FM, physical models, formant, wavetable, organ, TINE and more), struck bodies, 33 drum machines after the Machinedrum, an arp, articulation envelopes and a glue compressor.

remotefm1.author: Quixotic7
remotefm1.what: I heard you liked firmwares: the firmware that runs these firmwares, running as one of them. On its own RemoteFM1 is a DX7 with Yamaha's 256 ROM voices, a looper, an arp and scales; on an FM-1 it is also a MIDI controller, and the panel for RemoteFM1 itself.

ripple.author: Charles Vestal
ripple.what: Instruments written in Lua (droplets) playing sounds written in Faust or C (currents), inspired by norns. Built-in droplets to start; add your own as Lua scripts in your RemoteFM1 folder (code/ripple/droplets) and pick "reload folder". A Fantasy CFW: runs in RemoteFM1 only, never on an FM-1.

rupture.author: SikkenWorks
rupture.what: RUPTURE is a monophonic bass synth on Cycle Exchange Synthesis, with a band-limited saw as the alternative oscillator and two sub-oscillators for weight. A SOUND SHAPE page, a resonant ladder filter, Channel EQ and eight effects from MOSFET drive to octave fuzz shape it; a 128-step sequencer, arpeggiator, Scale Guide and 12 projects of 8 sequences round it out. Its sound starts about 6 s after power-on, as on the unit.

s1vave.what: A synth after the Roland S-1 and the SH-101: a punchy sub-oscillator, a resonant filter, bass and lead sounds and hands-on controls for playing live. Built on OberVave.
s1vave.author: Andrew GG

sid.author: Joakim Eriksson
sid.what: FM-1 SID turns the FM-1 into a Commodore 64: C64 music and GoatTracker 2 songs through a reSID-emulated SID, with GoatTracker's ten example songs. Write and save your own in the built-in GoatTracker editor, or switch to the SID synth with 12 instruments and a three-track step sequencer. Chorus, delay and reverb, 6581 or 8580.

sid1.author: putchdev
sid1.what: SID-1 turns the FM-1 into two Commodore 64 SID chips, six voices, 6581 or 8580, on an accurate port of reSID. Patches work like a C64 music player's instruments: ADSR, sync and ring, an 8-step wavetable for drums and arps, pulse and filter sweeps, vibrato and hard restart. 128 patches in 4 banks; layer, split, or play six voices over MIDI like a C64 tune.

sidj.author: Thomas Jansson
sidj.what: SiDJ turns the FM-1 into a Commodore 64 music deck: SID tunes on a cycle-exact emulated C64 with a 6581 or 8580, every voice remixable live (transpose, mute and solo, swap waveforms, bend envelopes and the filter, LFOs, tempo and a vinyl fader), with a MIDI clock taken from the tune. Ships with two tunes by its author, Thomas Jansson (tubesockor); add your own .sid files from its songs page.

sidou.author: dsablic
sidou.what: SIDOU turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID music machine: two SID chips with 6581 and 8580 character, effect slots and LAB for your own sounds. Write songs with STEP and a GoatTracker 2 compatible tracker, with SID drums and dice-rolled patterns, play .sid tunes on its own 6502, or play the chips live from the keys or over MIDI.

skiff.what: Six tracks of synths and drums with a groovebox's workflow: fourteen engines, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and locks, songs, PERFORM with scenes, six themes and a browser editor; FM6 sounds built from scratch on the unit. Built on Felucca, with most of Felucca 1.6.1's work brought over (the second core, MIDI LEARN, INSERT); Felucca's sounds and projects load. Also runs on the SMK-37 Pro. Coming from 1.x: 2.0 saves in new formats – update on Skiff's own page (it backs up and converts), or back up in its editor first.
skiff.author: illuminus5

sloop.what: A live groovebox: tracks, layers, a step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples, played on the FM-1 in real time.
sloop.author: isod89

smileyface.author: pbarilla
smileyface.what: Smileyface turns the FM-1 into an acid bass line machine: one squelchy voice, 16-step patterns with accents and slides, 16 patterns a project and 12 projects. Write a line on the keys or smash LFO for a random pattern, then twist cutoff, resonance, env mod and decay. FLY and WALK views turn the pattern into a little shooter game, and a grinning smiley reacts to every accent.

speak37.what: The talking synth, its FM-1 build: every key speaks the next word of a sentence at its pitch and chords speak in harmony; nine voices, 20 banks of sentences and songs, RHYTHM with an 808.
speak37.author: M. Geisler

spellbox.author: pjac1810
spellbox.what: SPELLBOX turns the FM-1 into a talking spelling toy after the 1978 Speak & Spell: the blue-green display, a 10-pole LPC voice at 8 kHz and A to Z on the keys. SPELL, LETTER, SAY IT, SECRET CODE and MYSTERY WORD over four levels; SPEAK reads what you type, SING plays words across the keyboard, and circuit-bending knobs make it a bent toy. All speech newly made with espeak-ng.

tessera.author: Theo Dainis
tessera.what: Tessera is a generative firmware grown from Melodee: each of four tracks plays its own steps, an arpeggio or one of thirteen generators (Turing, Euclid, Markov, Grids-style ATLAS and more). EVOLVE mutates phrases, FORM builds song sections and cords modulate anything from anything, through FM6, ORACLE, TRIO, PHYS and an 808/909 DRUM engine with insert and send effects.

tonitor.what: Six tracks for live ambient and experimental music: three synth engines, patches generated by algorithm, free-length loops with up to ten overdubs each, a granulator, filters and a lush reverb.
tonitor.author: N. Zimas

trax.author: jartificer
trax.what: Turns the FM-1 into a Sega Mega Drive / Genesis music tracker: the YM2612 (six FM channels) and the SN76489 PSG, emulated, with a pattern tracker in the style of Deflemask and Furnace played from the keys and knobs. Ships with the demo song Sunset Beach Galaxy by Tobikomi.

vector37.author: genkigenki
vector37.what: Vector37 is an orbiting overtone synth: four corners are planets with two overtone generators, a blend and a filter each, a sun travels a path and a moon circles it, and the moon's distance to each planet sets how much of that corner you hear, all on one animated orbit screen. 32 factory sounds, wavetables, an arpeggiator, chords, freeze and latch. Inspired by the Beetlecrab Vector.

vesper.author: Fat Cat Studios
vesper.what: VESPER is an ambient worship synth: 16 scenes, each layering four lush voices (pads, plucks, piano, swells) in any major key around a crystal orbit home screen. One SPACE knob adds grains, shimmer, reverb and echo, a global chain of DIRT, TONE, TEXTURE and VERB + DELAY shapes the mix, and you play live over the scene or record into it.

x0x.what: A groovebox: 909 and 808 drums, two 303s with TB-3PO, a breakbeat generator and song mode.
x0x.author: C. Vestal

zen1.author: aceyprime
zen1.what: Ambient as a living window: cherry petals on a river, koi in a pond, fireflies under a real moon, and every movement a note. Set it down and let it play; the keys play along, the knobs shape the scene.
